name: Remaliah
overview: Remaliah is identified in Scripture as the father of Pekah, who became king of Israel by conspiring against and killing his predecessor, as recorded in 2 Kings 15:25. Pekah son of Remaliah reigned for twenty years and was involved in significant conflicts, including a siege against Ahaz king of Judah alongside Rezin king of Syria (2 Kings 15:27; 16:5). His reign was marked by violent opposition, ultimately being slain by Hoshea (2 Kings 15:30). The account emphasizes the consequences of forsaking the LORD, as Pekah’s violent actions against Judah are linked to their unfaithfulness (2 Chronicles 28:6).
